name: ArSL21L classes (32), NOT reviewed
note: The labels are the 32 class names of the ArSL21L dataset (which the ASLAD landmark CSV uses too). 'display' is the Arabic letter to show a person and is filled in ONLY where the mapping is not in doubt; null = the team has to decide (see 'todo'). 'aliases' maps other spellings, and the Arabic letters that are certain, to a label. Letters of another dataset that cannot be resolved here (for example ت ط ة ه ح ي ى ظ ض, or Space, Delete, Finish) are skipped and counted by the importers, never guessed. 'dynamic' stays empty until the team confirms which letters are drawn in the air; every picture and landmark in these datasets is a still sign.
